title: lookup_legal_entity result
description: GLEIF LEI records as the GLEIF API answered at observed_at. A value that GLEIF leaves out is null. An LEI that GLEIF does not hold gives count 0 and an empty records list.

query.description: The checked request: the LEI, or the name and the page size that the tool used.

total_matches.description: For a name search, the number of matching records that GLEIF reports, which can be larger than count. null for an LEI lookup or when GLEIF leaves it out.

golden_copy_published_at.description: meta.goldenCopy.publishDate as GLEIF gives it: the publication time of the data set that answered.

source.description: The https address the tool read.

jurisdiction.description: entity.jurisdiction, for example CH or US-DE.

legal_form_id.description: entity.legalForm.id, an ISO 20275 entity legal form code.

entity_status.description: entity.status, for example ACTIVE or INACTIVE.

registration_status.description: registration.status, for example ISSUED, LAPSED or RETIRED.

managing_lou.description: registration.managingLou, the LEI of the issuing organisation that manages the record.
